name: openclaw-router
description: Local cost-optimizing LLM router for OpenClaw. Routes between local Ollama / llama.cpp and hosted OpenAI-compatible upstreams per request, via a 14-dimension weighted scorer. Zero external deps. Anthropic-format support removed; OpenAI Chat Completions only.

providers.description: Per-provider upstream config. Each entry: { baseUrl, auth: bearer|none, apiKeyEnv? }

models.description: Tier model assignments. Each tier is either a bare model id (uses defaultProvider) or { provider, model, stripThinking? }.

scoring.description: 14-dim scorer config (weights, boundaries, keyword lists, overrides).

upstreamAllowlist.description: TODO (deferred). When enforced, provider.baseUrl hostnames must match one of these patterns. Empty = trust operator (default config only).

providers.label: Upstream providers
providers.description: Local-only mode if no apiKeyEnv is set anywhere.

scoring.label: Scoring rules
scoring.description: Edit weights and keyword lists to bias which tier handles a request.
